scoring_justification: Headline quantities are derived algebraically from fixed inputs; comparing against paper-reported values with tolerances is the primary verification. Internal consistency checks add robustness. Recomputing from raw Seebeck would duplicate the agent's computation; thus T0 is appropriate.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold [MnB4+]/[MnB3+] ratio and effective p' values for degeneracy 5/4 and 10/4
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Tables 2 and 3, sample SC900 at temperatures 110,210,395,595,795,860 °C. For 10/4 case at 395°C, S = -97.3 μV/K per Table 3.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from published tables; cross-checked with solve.sh computed outputs to ensure full-reward reachability.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly taken from the paper's reported values; they are the experiment's published result.

outputs.description: Table of cation distribution for the SC900 sample computed under degeneracy ratio 5/4. The Seebeck_uVK column must match the provided input values exactly; the remaining columns must be self-consistent and follow the modified Heikes formula and spinel distribution formula.

Table of cation distribution for the SC900 sample computed under degeneracy ratio 10/4. The Seebeck_uVK column must match the provided input values exactly; the remaining columns must be self-consistent and follow the modified Heikes formula and spinel distribution formula.

output_contract.notes: The solving agent is provided the six Seebeck coefficient values and the physical constants (kB, e) in the instruction. The tables must be computed algorithmically from those inputs; no external lookup of published values is allowed. The checker will verify both the internal consistency between ratio, p', and occupancies, and compare the computed ratio and p' columns to hidden reference values within appropriate tolerances.
